verdict_rule: stats_family.verdict on the 95% interval: equivalent -m < lo and hi < m; non-inferior only hi < m and lo <= -m; inferior lo > 0 and hi >= m; inconclusive otherwise
notes: Analysis A describes what the verdict rule of the principal comparison returns for comparators whose quality relative to the specialist is known from other evidence; it adds no planned comparison and changes no verdict of the principal comparison. The rule makespans do not depend on a training seed, so the seed level of the interval resamples the specialist only. The columns read from records are not recomputed.
sign: d = 100 (first-named - second) / second; the comparators are first-named, the specialist of the combination second; positive = the comparator is longer
best_rule: per instance the shortest of the FIFO, MOR, SPT and MWKR schedules (p88_family_inference.pool); the rule makespans do not depend on a training seed

ten.stream: one default_rng(110) stream in the order ['N', 'L', 'S', 'W', 'LS', 'LW', 'SW', 'LSW'], a fresh default_rng(110) for the pooled row

five.stream: one default_rng(11) stream in the order ['N', 'L', 'S', 'W', 'LS', 'LW', 'SW', 'LSW'], a fresh default_rng(11) for the pooled row

policy_minus_rule.source: results/family_inference.json (scripts/p88_family_inference.py), key rule_pool (the FamRule macros); pooled row from results/production_specialists.json (scripts/p128_production_specialists.py), side_by_side.rows.10x25.rule
policy_minus_rule.verdict_rule: ahead: hierarchical 95% CI below zero and both Holm-adjusted one-sided p-values (seed-level t, bootstrap; H1 first arm faster) below 0.05; behind: CI above zero and both Holm-adjusted one-sided p-values for H1 first arm slower (own Holm family over the eight combinations) below 0.05; not distinguishable otherwise
policy_minus_rule.pooled_word: direction of the pooled interval (the record has no combined verdict for the pooled row)

cross.source: computed from the arrays of the cross campaign with the readers of scripts/p100_cross_eval.py and p95.component (no record compares these runs with the specialist of the combination)
cross.unit: cell (specialist X run under combination C)
cross.sign: d = 100 (specialist X under C - specialist of C) / specialist of C
